$comment: Resource & Asset Management clean deployment. Names are idempotency keys; Workflow Manager is authoritative.

workflowItem.title: Resource & Asset Management Workflow 20261028
workflowItem.description: EOC resource request, approval, mobilization, deployment, demobilization, return, and close workflow.

logistics.title: EOC — Logistics Section 20261028
logistics.description: Review, source, dispatch, and restock resources.

diagram.name: EOC Resource Request / Approval v2 20261028
diagram.description: Validated resource request lifecycle with Workflow Manager as authority.

steps.name: Request Submitted
steps.prompt: A resource request has been submitted. Acknowledge and route it to Logistics.

steps.name: Logistics Review
steps.prompt: Validate NIMS typing, quantity, priority, incident, and inventory availability.

steps.name: Approve Request?
steps.question: Approve this resource request? A decision note is required in the application.

steps.name: Source / Commit Resource
steps.prompt: Select and commit the resource; record sourcing details.

email.subject: "'Resource ready to deploy: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'request_title')"
email.body:
"'

Your requested resource is ready to deploy.

Request: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'request_title') + '

Incident: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'incident_name') + '

'"

steps.name: Deploy / In Use
steps.prompt: Confirm arrival, record the deployment site and address, and move the resource geometry to the confirmed deployment point.

steps.name: Ready to Return?
steps.question: Is the resource ready to demobilize?

steps.name: Demobilize
steps.prompt: Demobilize the resource and coordinate return.

steps.name: Return & Restock
steps.prompt: Confirm the return location and address, move the resource geometry to staging, inspect it, and make it available after restocking.

email.subject: "'Resource returned: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'request_title')"
email.body:
"'

Your requested resource has been returned and restocked.

Request: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'request_title') + '

Incident: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'incident_name') + '

'"

steps.name: Record Denial
steps.prompt: Record the denial reason and notify the requestor.

email.subject: "'Resource request denied: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'request_title')"
email.body:
"'

Your resource request was denied.

Request: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'request_title') + '

Incident: ' + JobExtendedProperty($Job, 'resource_request', 'incident_name') + '

Review the request and denial reason before deciding whether to resubmit.

'"

steps.name: Request Closed
steps.prompt: Acknowledge final closeout. The request and job are complete.
